## Purpose

Apply the final models to observed program adoption and estimate the cumulative effect in noncore counties through event year 4 (Section 2.2), with covariates and the full sample. All six models with covariates are the main analysis; RW-IID and RW-ST without covariates are a supplement check on how much the estimates lean on covariate adjustment. Heterogeneity is assessed with the placebo-calibrated test (`04_injected_effects.qmd`), not the IQR of county estimates. 200 predictive draws per model, matching the placebo calibration.

```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(Matrix)
invisible(lapply(list.files("R", "[.]r$", full.names = TRUE), source))
source("R/backdate.r")   # backdate_covariate_panel(): covariates scaled as in 02
out <- "data/derived/case_study"
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
covariates <- c("uemp", "pov", "mhinc", "aian")
original <- as.data.table(readRDS(panel_file()))
# `long` records post-adoption program activity: never a model input; joined back later.
long_share <- copy(original)[, .(i, year, long = long)]
panels <- list(
  wcov = backdate_covariate_panel(original)[, c("i", "year", "start_year", "urb", "y", "n", covariates), with = FALSE],
  wocov = original[, .(i, year, start_year, urb, y, n)])
rm(original)
load("data/W"); rownames(W) <- NULL
options(xpn.conf = list(Lset = c(2, 4), graph = Matrix(W)))
Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1, MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1)
INLA::inla.setOption(num.threads = 1)
model_levels <- c("TWFE", "ETWFE", "RW", "RW-IID", "RW-ST", "GB-Ens")
```

## Fits

Observed adoption: `set_y0()` without a placebo schedule, so each county's cohort and first masked year are its actual adoption year; untreated outcomes before adoption are the training data. Models as in the placebo study: TWFE and ETWFE with common covariate coefficients; the nested RW, RW-IID and RW-ST with default priors; GB-Ens with the ETWFE baseline. Fixed seeds per model.

```{r fit-specs}
nested <- function(iid, spatial, cv) function(x)
  fit_nested(x, structural_only = TRUE, iid = iid, spatial = spatial, covariates = cv)
case_models <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(spec = "wcov", model = model_levels, code = c("twfe", "etwfe", "rw", "rwi", "rwst", "xgb")),
  data.table(spec = "wocov", model = c("RW-IID", "RW-ST"), code = c("rwi", "rwst"))))
case_models[, `:=`(seed = 20261022L + .I, path = file.path(out, sprintf("fit_%s_%s.rds", spec, code)))]
fit_args <- function(spec, model) {
  cv <- if (spec == "wcov") covariates else NULL
  rhs <- if (length(cv)) paste(cv, collapse = " + ") else "1"
  switch(model,
    TWFE = list(fun = impute_fe, args = list(fm = as.formula(paste("y0 ~", rhs, "| i + year")))),
    ETWFE = list(fun = impute_fe, args = list(fm = as.formula(paste("y0 ~", rhs, "| cell + year")))),
    RW = list(fun = impute_inla, args = list(fit_fun = nested(FALSE, FALSE, cv))),
    `RW-IID` = list(fun = impute_inla, args = list(fit_fun = nested(TRUE, FALSE, cv))),
    `RW-ST` = list(fun = impute_inla, args = list(fit_fun = nested(FALSE, TRUE, cv))),
    `GB-Ens` = list(fun = impute_xgb, args = list(predictors = cv, verbose = FALSE)))
}
fwrite(case_models[, .(spec, model, code, seed, path)], file.path(out, "case_models_and_seeds.csv"))
case_models[, .(spec, model, seed, exists = file.exists(path))]
```

```{r fit, eval=isTRUE(params$refit)}
draws <- paste0("y0_post_", seq_len(params$nboot))
todo <- case_models[!file.exists(path)]
res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(todo)), function(k) {
  m <- todo[k]
  dt <- copy(panels[[m$spec]])
  set_y0(dt)
  sp <- fit_args(m$spec, m$model)
  set.seed(m$seed)
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  do.call(fit_blind, c(list(dt = dt, .impute = sp$fun, nboot = params$nboot), sp$args))
  fit <- dt[, c("i", "year", "start_year", "cohort", "urb", "y", "n", "y0_hat", draws), with = FALSE]
  saveRDS(list(fit = fit, provenance = attr(dt, "xgb_provenance"), seed = m$seed, git = git_state(),
    seconds = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))), m$path)
  m$path
}, mc.cores = params$mc_cores, mc.set.seed = FALSE)
failed <- vapply(res, inherits, NA, "try-error")
if (any(failed)) stop(sum(failed), " case-study fits failed; first: ", res[[which(failed)[1]]])
```

```{r load}
fits <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(case_models)), function(k) {
  m <- case_models[k]
  if (!file.exists(m$path)) return(NULL)
  f <- readRDS(m$path)
  f$fit[, `:=`(spec = m$spec, model = m$model)]
}))
fits[, s := year - start_year]
fits[, nc := fifelse(urb == "6.NonCore", "NonCore", "Core")]
fits[, model := factor(model, model_levels)]
```

## Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
# Counties per event year (noncore adopters, post-adoption rows within years 0-4), and missing predictions.
post <- fits[nc == "NonCore" & is.finite(start_year) & s >= 0 & s <= 4]
cnt <- post[, .(counties = uniqueN(i), missing_prediction = uniqueN(i[!is.finite(y0_hat)])), by = .(spec, model, s)]
dcast(cnt, spec + model ~ s, value.var = "counties")
dcast(cnt, spec + model ~ s, value.var = "missing_prediction")
# Pre-period fit (in-sample RMSE of y0_hat over untreated years), noncore adopters.
fits[nc == "NonCore" & is.finite(start_year) & s < 0, .(pre_rmse = sqrt(mean((y - y0_hat)^2, na.rm = TRUE))), by = .(spec, model)]
```

## Cumulative effects (checks; exhibits after review)

Noncore adopters; the common sample of counties with a prediction from every fitted model (as in the placebo results). Main: the balanced sample, counties observed at every event year 0–4, so all horizons use the same counties (late adopters, with fewer post-adoption years in the panel, would otherwise enter and leave the sample with time since adoption); sensitivity: the counties observed at each event year.

```{r effects}
nc_fits <- fits[nc == "NonCore"]
common <- nc_fits[is.finite(start_year) & s >= 0 & s <= 4, .(ok = all(is.finite(y0_hat))), by = .(i, s)]
nc_fits <- nc_fits[common[ok == TRUE], on = .(i, s), nomatch = 0L]
cum <- case_cumulative(nc_fits)
eff <- rbind(case_effects(cum)[, sample := "Observed at each event year"],
  case_effects(cum, balanced = TRUE)[, sample := "Balanced (all event years 0-4)"])
fwrite(eff, file.path(out, "case_effects.csv"))
dcast(eff[s == 4], spec + model ~ sample, value.var = "counties")
eff[s == 4, .(spec, model, sample, effect = round(effect, 3), lo = round(effect_lo, 3), hi = round(effect_hi, 3),
  rr = round(rr, 2), rr_lo = round(rr_lo, 2), rr_hi = round(rr_hi, 2))]
```

## Heterogeneity test (checks)

Noncore counties with all five post-adoption years, cumulative through event year 4. p-values against the E0 placebo null of the same model and specification (`04b`), (1 + #{null ≥ observed}) / (1 + 200); the reported p is the largest across the three scenarios. Matched-size sensitivity: 200 random subsets of 45 counties (the size of the placebo evaluation sets), p per subset, averaged.

```{r het-test}
draws <- grep("^y0_post_", names(cum), value = TRUE)
c4 <- cum[cum[, .I[max(s) == 4], by = .(spec, model, i)]$V1][s == 4]
h <- c4[, .(spec, model, i, y, mu = y0_hat, var_mu = matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(.SD))), .SDcols = draws]
null <- readRDS("_output/analysis/output/04/heterogeneity_test.rds")[sigma == 0]
null[, spec := fifelse(specification == "With covariates", "wcov", "wocov")]
obs <- heterogeneity_stats(h, by = c("spec", "model"))
pv <- rbindlist(lapply(c("T", "T_minus1", "Qstar"), function(st) obs[, {
  nl <- null[spec == .BY$spec & model == .BY$model]
  rbindlist(lapply(split(nl, by = "dgp"), function(z) data.table(dgp = z$dgp[1], p = placebo_p(get(st), z[[st]]))))
}, by = .(spec, model)][, statistic := st]))
sub <- rbindlist(lapply(split(h, by = c("spec", "model"), drop = TRUE), function(z)
  heterogeneity_subsets(z)[, `:=`(spec = z$spec[1], model = z$model[1])]))
pv_sub <- rbindlist(lapply(c("T", "T_minus1", "Qstar"), function(st) sub[, {
  nl <- null[spec == .BY$spec & model == .BY$model]
  rbindlist(lapply(split(nl, by = "dgp"), function(z) {
    p <- vapply(get(st), placebo_p, 0, null = z[[st]])
    data.table(dgp = z$dgp[1], p_mean = mean(p), p_median = stats::median(p))
  }))
}, by = .(spec, model)][, statistic := st]))
het_case <- merge(pv, pv_sub, by = c("spec", "model", "statistic", "dgp"))
fwrite(obs, file.path(out, "heterogeneity_observed.csv"))
fwrite(het_case, file.path(out, "heterogeneity_pvalues.csv"))
obs[, .(spec, model, n, n_mu_lt1, T = round(T, 2), T_minus1 = round(T_minus1, 2), Qstar = round(Qstar, 2), top10 = round(top10_share_T_numerator, 2))]
het_case[, .(p_max = max(p), p_sub_mean_max = max(p_mean)), by = .(spec, model, statistic)][order(statistic, spec, model)]
```

## Effect modification by long-training share (checks)

Same counties as the heterogeneity test. Long-training share: the mean of `long` over each county's post-adoption years 0–4 with training records. For each of the 200 latent predictive draws μ⁽ᵈ⁾, quasi-Poisson regression O ~ x, offset log μ⁽ᵈ⁾, dispersion floored at 1; 5 normal draws per d pooled; Rubin's rules as a check. x: percentile rank scaled 0–1 (primary) and the share per 10 percentage points (secondary). Sensitivity: adjusted for log youth population (log mean n over post years 0–4).

```{r em-case}
share <- long_share[, .(i, year, long)]
x_dt <- unique(c4[, .(i, start_year)])[share, on = "i", nomatch = 0L][year >= start_year & year <= start_year + 4,
  .(share = mean(long, na.rm = TRUE)), by = i]
pop <- nc_fits[is.finite(start_year) & s >= 0 & s <= 4, .(log_pop = log(mean(n))), by = i]
x_dt <- merge(x_dt, unique(pop), by = "i")
stopifnot(!anyNA(x_dt$share))
em_case <- rbindlist(lapply(split(c4, by = c("spec", "model"), drop = TRUE), function(z) {
  z <- merge(z, x_dt, by = "i")
  D <- as.matrix(z[, ..draws])
  rbindlist(list(
    em_fit(z$y, D, em_rank(z$share), seed = 1L)[, `:=`(x = "rank", adjusted = FALSE)],
    em_fit(z$y, D, em_rank(z$share), z = z$log_pop, seed = 1L)[, `:=`(x = "rank", adjusted = TRUE)],
    em_fit(z$y, D, em_per10(z$share), seed = 1L)[, `:=`(x = "per 10 pp", adjusted = FALSE)],
    em_fit(z$y, D, em_per10(z$share), z = z$log_pop, seed = 1L)[, `:=`(x = "per 10 pp", adjusted = TRUE)]
  ))[, `:=`(spec = z$spec[1], model = z$model[1])]
}))
fwrite(em_case, file.path(out, "effect_modification_case.csv"))
em_case[, .(spec, model, x, adjusted, n = counties, exp_beta = round(exp(beta), 2), lo = round(exp(lo), 2), hi = round(exp(hi), 2),
  share_between = round(share_between, 2), phi_med = round(phi_median, 2), phi_min = round(phi_min, 2), phi_max = round(phi_max, 2))]
# Reading rule inputs: long-training share vs size, and vs pre-period fit (RW-ST, with covariates).
pre_fit <- fits[spec == "wcov" & model == "RW-ST" & nc == "NonCore" & is.finite(start_year) & s < 0,
  .(pre_rmse = sqrt(mean((y - y0_hat)^2))), by = i]
rel <- merge(x_dt, pre_fit, by = "i")
data.table(counties = nrow(rel), zero_share = sum(rel$share == 0),
  spearman_share_logpop = cor(rel$share, rel$log_pop, method = "spearman"),
  spearman_share_pre_rmse = cor(rel$share, rel$pre_rmse, method = "spearman"))
```

## Effect-modification model on the placebo (calibration)

The same procedure on the E0 placebo replications: noncore pseudo-treated counties observed through event year 4 (the common sample), with x drawn for each replication from the case-study long-training shares (without replacement, fixed seed per scenario and replication, the same across models), because the long-training share is undefined for placebo-treated counties (missing before adoption and for never-treated counties). Log population is the county's own. Rank x, unadjusted and adjusted.

```{r em-placebo}
em_path <- file.path(out, "effect_modification_placebo.rds")
case_shares <- x_dt$share
if (!file.exists(em_path)) {
  em_null <- rbindlist(lapply(c(wcov = "data/simulation/placebo_sample_wcov.rds", wocov = "data/simulation/placebo_sample_wocov.rds"), function(p) {
    sp <- if (grepl("wcov", p)) "wcov" else "wocov"
    keep_models <- unique(case_models[spec == sp, model])
    f <- as.data.table(readRDS(p))[nc == "NonCore" & model %in% keep_models]
    f[, `:=`(model = as.character(model), dgp = as.character(dgp))]
    pd <- grep("^y0_post_", names(f), value = TRUE)
    setorderv(f, c("dgp", "model", "r", "i", "s"))
    f <- f[f[, .I[max(s) == 4], by = .(dgp, model, r, i)]$V1]
    agg <- f[, c(lapply(.SD, sum), list(pop = log(mean(n)))), by = .(dgp, model, r, i), .SDcols = c("y", pd)]
    rm(f); gc()
    groups <- unique(agg[, .(dgp, model)])
    res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(groups)), function(g) {
      gg <- groups[g]; a <- agg[dgp == gg$dgp & model == gg$model]
      rbindlist(lapply(split(a, by = "r"), function(z) {
        set.seed(20261024L + match(gg$dgp, c("MAR", "Latent level", "Latent trend")) * 1000L + z$r[1])
        sh <- sample(case_shares, nrow(z))
        D <- as.matrix(z[, ..pd])
        rbind(em_fit(z$y, D, em_rank(sh), seed = z$r[1])[, adjusted := FALSE],
          em_fit(z$y, D, em_rank(sh), z = z$pop, seed = z$r[1])[, adjusted := TRUE])[, `:=`(r = z$r[1])]
      }))[, `:=`(dgp = gg$dgp, model = gg$model)]
    }, mc.cores = 18, mc.set.seed = FALSE)
    rbindlist(res)[, spec := sp]
  }))
  saveRDS(em_null, em_path)
} else em_null <- readRDS(em_path)
fpr <- em_null[, .(fpr = mean(lo > 0 | hi < 0), fpr_se = sqrt(mean(lo > 0 | hi < 0) * (1 - mean(lo > 0 | hi < 0)) / .N),
  fpr_rubin = mean(rubin_lo > 0 | rubin_hi < 0), mean_beta_hat = mean(beta_hat_mean), phi_median = median(phi_median),
  reps = .N), by = .(spec, model, dgp, adjusted)]
fwrite(fpr, file.path(out, "effect_modification_placebo_fpr.csv"))
fpr[order(spec, model, adjusted, dgp)]
```

## Influence of the largest contributor (post hoc, descriptive)

One county contributes most of T's numerator in every model (see the checks above). Its identity and small counts are not shown (small-cell rules). Post hoc and descriptive: the year-4 effect and the effect-modification estimate without that county.

```{r influence}
num <- h[, { rr <- sum(y) / sum(mu); .(i, num = (y - rr * mu)^2 - rr * mu - rr^2 * var_mu) }, by = .(spec, model)]
top_i <- num[spec == "wcov" & model == "RW-ST"][which.max(num), i]
top_share <- num[, .(share = num[i == top_i] / sum(num)), by = .(spec, model)]
eff_drop <- case_effects(cum[i != top_i])[s == 4][, sample := "Without the largest contributor"]
em_drop <- rbindlist(lapply(split(c4[i != top_i], by = c("spec", "model"), drop = TRUE), function(z) {
  z <- merge(z, x_dt, by = "i"); D <- as.matrix(z[, ..draws])
  em_fit(z$y, D, em_rank(z$share), seed = 1L)[, `:=`(x = "rank", adjusted = FALSE, spec = z$spec[1], model = z$model[1])]
}))
fwrite(eff_drop, file.path(out, "case_effects_without_top_contributor.csv"))
fwrite(em_drop, file.path(out, "effect_modification_without_top_contributor.csv"))
top_share[, .(spec, model, share_of_T_numerator = round(share, 2))]
```

## Previous analysis: Spearman correlations (appendix only)

Kept for continuity with the earlier draft: per predictive draw (Poisson noise added), the Spearman correlation between the long-training share and the county cumulative effect through event year 4; mean and 2.5/97.5 percentiles over draws.

```{r spearman}
spearman <- rbindlist(lapply(split(c4, by = c("spec", "model"), drop = TRUE), function(z) {
  z <- merge(z, x_dt, by = "i"); D <- as.matrix(z[, ..draws])
  set.seed(20261025L)
  D[] <- rpois(length(D), D)
  rho <- apply(z$y - D, 2, function(e) cor(z$share, e, method = "spearman"))
  data.table(spec = z$spec[1], model = z$model[1], rho = mean(rho), lo = quantile(rho, 0.025), hi = quantile(rho, 0.975))
}))
fwrite(spearman, file.path(out, "spearman_previous.csv"))
spearman
```

## Exhibits

```{r exhibit-setup}
spec_lab <- c(wcov = "With covariates", wocov = "Without covariates")
fmt_ci <- function(e, lo, hi, d = 2) mt_minus(sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f (%.", d, "f, %.", d, "f)"), e, lo, hi))
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.01, "<0.01", sprintf("%.2f", p))
cols_case <- c(model_colors <- c(TWFE = "#1b9e77", ETWFE = "#66c2a5", RW = "#a6cee3",
  `RW-IID` = "#1f78b4", `RW-ST` = "#08306b", `GB-Ens` = "#e69f00"))
plot_effects <- function(d, title_spec = TRUE) {
  d <- copy(d)[, model := factor(model, model_levels)]
  ggplot(d, aes(s, effect, colour = model)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = effect_lo, ymax = effect_hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.25) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors, name = NULL, breaks = model_levels) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:4) +
    labs(x = "Event year (cumulative through)", y = "Observed minus predicted deaths\n(mean per noncore county)") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r fig-main, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.2}
# Main figure: cumulative effect by event year, six models with covariates, balanced sample.
p <- plot_effects(eff[spec == "wcov" & sample == "Balanced (all event years 0-4)"])
ggsave("results/figures/fig2_case_effects.png", p, width = 8, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)
p
```

```{r table-main}
# Main table: year-4 effect and rate ratio, heterogeneity test, effect modification (rank, unadjusted).
pmax_dt <- het_case[, .(p = max(p)), by = .(spec, model, statistic)]
main <- eff[spec == "wcov" & sample == "Balanced (all event years 0-4)" & s == 4,
  .(model = as.character(model), Effect = fmt_ci(effect, effect_lo, effect_hi), RR = fmt_ci(rr, rr_lo, rr_hi))]
main <- merge(main, dcast(pmax_dt[spec == "wcov" & statistic %in% c("T", "T_minus1")], model ~ statistic, value.var = "p")[,
  .(model = as.character(model), T = fmt_p(T), Tm1 = fmt_p(T_minus1))], by = "model")
main <- merge(main, em_case[spec == "wcov" & x == "rank" & adjusted == FALSE,
  .(model = as.character(model), EM = fmt_ci(exp(beta), exp(lo), exp(hi)))], by = "model")
main <- main[match(model_levels, model)]
fwrite(main, "results/tables/table3_case_study.csv")
n_case <- unique(c4[spec == "wcov", .(i)])[, .N]
build_case <- function(fmt) {
  g <- gt(as.data.frame(main), rowname_col = "model") |>
    tab_spanner("Cumulative effect, year 4", columns = c("Effect", "RR"), id = "eff") |>
    tab_spanner("Heterogeneity test, p", columns = c("T", "Tm1"), id = "het") |>
    cols_label(Effect = mt_label("Deaths per\ncounty (95% CI)", fmt), RR = mt_label("Rate ratio\n(95% CI)", fmt),
      T = "T", Tm1 = "T(−1)", EM = mt_label("Long trainings,\nexp(β) (95% CI)", fmt))
  notes <- c(
    sprintf("Noncore counties with five post-adoption years, cumulative through event year 4 (n = %d); models with covariates, full sample; 200 predictive draws per model.", n_case),
    "Deaths per county: mean observed minus predicted cumulative deaths; rate ratio: observed over predicted deaths. Intervals from the predictive draws with Poisson noise.",
    "Heterogeneity test: T tests whether county counts vary around the predictions more than expected from noise (weighted toward the largest counties); T(−1) drops the county with the largest contribution. p-values against the placebo null of the same model, the largest across the three simulation scenarios.",
    "Long trainings: ratio of rate ratios between the highest- and lowest-ranked county by long-training share (percentile rank), from a quasi-Poisson model with the prediction as offset, pooled over predictive draws.")
  for (nt in notes) g <- tab_source_note(g, nt)
  mt_style(g, stub = "model")
}
width <- save_manuscript_table(build_case, "results/tables/table3_case_study")
cat(sprintf("LaTeX width at 9 pt: %.2f in; overfull boxes: %d\n", width$width_in, width$overfull))
build_case("html")
```

```{r s2-tables}
# S2a: effects at year 4, all models and specifications: main sample beside the post hoc analysis without the
# largest contributor. At year 4 the balanced sample and the counties observed at that year coincide
# (same counties, same estimates), so only the balanced (main) sample is shown.
s2a_long <- rbind(eff[s == 4 & sample == "Balanced (all event years 0-4)"][, set := "all"], eff_drop[, set := "drop"], fill = TRUE)
s2a_long <- s2a_long[, .(spec = spec_lab[spec], model = factor(model, model_levels), set, counties,
  Effect = fmt_ci(effect, effect_lo, effect_hi), RR = fmt_ci(rr, rr_lo, rr_hi))]
s2a <- dcast(s2a_long, spec + model ~ set, value.var = c("Effect", "RR"))
s2a[, spec := factor(spec, spec_lab)]
setorder(s2a, spec, model)
s2a[, model := as.character(model)]
setcolorder(s2a, c("spec", "model", "Effect_all", "RR_all", "Effect_drop", "RR_drop"))
fwrite(s2a, "results/tables/tableS5_case_effects.csv")
n_s2a <- s2a_long[, .(n = unique(counties)), by = set]
stopifnot(n_s2a[, .N, by = set]$N == 1)
save_manuscript_table(function(fmt) {
  g <- gt(as.data.frame(s2a), groupname_col = "spec", rowname_col = "model") |>
    tab_spanner(sprintf("All counties (n = %d)", n_s2a[set == "all", n]), columns = c("Effect_all", "RR_all"), id = "all") |>
    tab_spanner(sprintf("Without the largest contributor (n = %d)", n_s2a[set == "drop", n]), columns = c("Effect_drop", "RR_drop"), id = "drop") |>
    cols_label(Effect_all = mt_label("Deaths per\ncounty (95% CI)", fmt), RR_all = mt_label("Rate ratio\n(95% CI)", fmt),
      Effect_drop = mt_label("Deaths per\ncounty (95% CI)", fmt), RR_drop = mt_label("Rate ratio\n(95% CI)", fmt))
  for (nt in c(
    "Noncore counties with five post-adoption years, cumulative through event year 4; 200 predictive draws per model. All counties: the main sample of Table [C1] (with covariates); at event year 4 it coincides with the counties observed at that year.",
    "Deaths per county: mean observed minus predicted cumulative deaths; rate ratio: observed over predicted deaths. Intervals from the predictive draws with Poisson noise.",
    "Without the largest contributor: drops the county contributing most to the heterogeneity statistic T (post hoc, descriptive; its identity is withheld). Without covariates: RW-IID and RW-ST only."))
    g <- tab_source_note(g, nt)
  mt_style(g, stub = "model")
}, "results/tables/tableS5_case_effects")

# S2b: heterogeneity test grid.
s2b <- merge(dcast(het_case, spec + model + statistic ~ dgp, value.var = "p"),
  het_case[, .(p_max = max(p), p_subsets = max(p_mean)), by = .(spec, model, statistic)], by = c("spec", "model", "statistic"))
s2b <- merge(s2b, melt(obs[, .(spec, model, T, T_minus1, Qstar)], id.vars = c("spec", "model"), variable.name = "statistic", value.name = "observed"),
  by = c("spec", "model", "statistic"))
s2b[, `:=`(Specification = spec_lab[spec], Statistic = factor(statistic, c("T", "T_minus1", "Qstar"), c("T", "T(−1)", "Q* (secondary)")))]
s2b_out <- s2b[, .(Specification, model = as.character(model), Statistic, Observed = mt_minus(sprintf("%.2f", observed)),
  MAR = fmt_p(MAR), `Latent level` = fmt_p(`Latent level`), `Latent trend` = fmt_p(`Latent trend`),
  `p (max)` = fmt_p(p_max), `p, 45-county subsets` = fmt_p(p_subsets))]
setorder(s2b_out, Specification, Statistic, model)
fwrite(s2b_out, "results/tables/tableS6_case_heterogeneity.csv")
# Table: models with covariates only, as in the rest of the case study (the CSV keeps RW-IID and RW-ST without).
s2b_tab <- s2b_out[Specification == spec_lab[["wcov"]]][, Specification := NULL]
s2b_tab[, model := factor(model, model_levels)]
setorder(s2b_tab, Statistic, model)
s2b_tab[, model := as.character(model)]
save_manuscript_table(function(fmt) {
  g <- gt(as.data.frame(s2b_tab), groupname_col = "Statistic", rowname_col = "model") |>
    tab_spanner("p against the placebo null, by scenario", columns = c("MAR", "Latent level", "Latent trend"), id = "p") |>
    cols_label(`p, 45-county subsets` = mt_label("p, 45-county\nsubsets", fmt))
  for (nt in c("Noncore counties with five post-adoption years, cumulative through event year 4; models with covariates.",
    "p = (1 + number of placebo replications with a statistic at least as large) / 201, against the E0 placebo null of the same model (with covariates); p (max) is the largest across scenarios. 45-county subsets: mean p over 200 random subsets of 45 counties (the size of the placebo evaluation sets), largest across scenarios.",
    sprintf("The county contributing most to T accounts for %.0f%%–%.0f%% of its numerator across models (identity withheld).",
      100 * min(top_share[spec == "wcov", share]), 100 * max(top_share[spec == "wcov", share]))))
    g <- tab_source_note(g, nt)
  mt_style(g, stub = "model")
}, "results/tables/tableS6_case_heterogeneity")

# S2c: effect modification, all models, both scalings, adjusted and unadjusted, with calibration.
fpr_w <- fpr[, .(fpr = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", min(fpr), max(fpr))), by = .(spec, model, adjusted)]
s2c <- merge(em_case, fpr_w, by = c("spec", "model", "adjusted"), all.x = TRUE)
s2c_out <- s2c[, .(Specification = spec_lab[spec], model = as.character(model),
  Exposure = fifelse(x == "rank", "Percentile rank", "Per 10 percentage points"), Adjustment = fifelse(adjusted, "Log population", "None"),
  `exp(β) (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(exp(beta), exp(lo), exp(hi)), `Rubin 95% CI` = mt_minus(sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f)", exp(rubin_lo), exp(rubin_hi))),
  `Between-draw share` = sprintf("%.2f", share_between), Dispersion = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", phi_median, phi_min, phi_max),
  `Placebo FPR` = fifelse(x == "rank", fpr, "—"))]
setorder(s2c_out, Specification, Exposure, Adjustment, model)
fwrite(s2c_out, "results/tables/tableS7_case_effect_modification.csv")
# Table: models with covariates, percentile-rank exposure (the CSV also keeps the models without covariates and
# the secondary per-10-percentage-point scaling).
s2c_tab <- s2c_out[Specification == spec_lab[["wcov"]] & Exposure == "Percentile rank"][, `:=`(Specification = NULL, Exposure = NULL)]
s2c_tab[, `:=`(model = factor(model, model_levels), Adjustment = factor(Adjustment, c("None", "Log population"),
  c("Unadjusted", "Adjusted for log population")))]
setorder(s2c_tab, Adjustment, model)
s2c_tab[, model := as.character(model)]
save_manuscript_table(function(fmt) {
  g <- gt(as.data.frame(s2c_tab), groupname_col = "Adjustment", rowname_col = "model") |>
    cols_label(`Between-draw share` = mt_label("Between-draw\nshare", fmt), `Placebo FPR` = mt_label("Placebo\nFPR", fmt))
  rel_note <- sprintf("Long-training share: zero in %d of %d counties; Spearman correlation with log population %.2f and with pre-period fit (RMSE, RW-ST) %.2f.",
    sum(rel$share == 0), nrow(rel), cor(rel$share, rel$log_pop, method = "spearman"), cor(rel$share, rel$pre_rmse, method = "spearman"))
  for (nt in c("Noncore counties with five post-adoption years, cumulative through event year 4; models with covariates. exp(β): ratio of rate ratios between the highest- and lowest-ranked county by long-training share (percentile rank, 0–1); quasi-Poisson with the predicted count as offset, fitted per predictive draw (200), dispersion floored at 1, intervals from 5 normal draws per draw pooled; Rubin's rules as a check.",
    "Dispersion: median (range) of the unfloored quasi-Poisson dispersion across draws. Between-draw share: share of Rubin's total variance from the spread of estimates across predictive draws.",
    "Placebo FPR: share of E0 placebo replications (200 per scenario) whose 95% interval for β excludes zero, with the long-training share drawn from the case-study values; range across the three scenarios.",
    rel_note))
    g <- tab_source_note(g, nt)
  mt_style(g, stub = "model")
}, "results/tables/tableS7_case_effect_modification")

# S2d: previous analysis (Spearman), for continuity.
s2d <- spearman[, .(Specification = spec_lab[spec], model = as.character(model), `Spearman ρ (95% interval)` = fmt_ci(rho, lo, hi))]
fwrite(s2d, file.path(out, "tableS2_case_spearman_previous.csv"))
save_manuscript_table(function(fmt) {
  g <- gt(as.data.frame(s2d), groupname_col = "Specification", rowname_col = "model")
  g <- tab_source_note(g, "Previous analysis: Spearman correlation between long-training share and county cumulative effect through event year 4, per predictive draw (Poisson noise added); mean and 2.5th/97.5th percentiles over 200 draws. Superseded by the effect-modification model.")
  mt_style(g, stub = "model")
}, file.path(out, "tableS2_case_spearman_previous"))
```
